CRIS.name: Camera
CRIS.note: The scene's camera: the field of view on the player's camera, and how fast that changes. [documented: xEdit wbDefinitionsFO4.pas (Mozilla Public License 1.1), wbStruct(CRIS, 'Camera', [...]). measured: of the nine CRIS subrecords in Fallout4.esm, seven are four bytes and hold only the field of view, and two are eight bytes and hold both.]

struct.name: Rate Of Camera Change
struct.note: Absent when the subrecord is only four bytes long.
